cv_protocol.fold_isolation: Strict two-stage isolation: fold-j predictors train strictly on dga_tr_j (fitted on tr_j alone) and evaluate strictly against independent dga_te_j (fitted on te_j alone) + model-free Test PBR.

regime_I_global_full_activation_11p8_to_.description: Pure-TM6 global activation endpoints A_TM6 (R_TM6 <= 11.8 A) -> B_TM6 (R_TM6 >= 15.2 A) on pooled 3-CV receptor coordinates (zero ligand-identity input, stratified macro-block CV); matched intermediate evaluation slice [12.5, 14.5] A (>= 0.7 A buffered from A and B).
